base: black gesso; liquid clear; alizarin crimson; phthalo blue corner

steps.subject: other: base wash
steps.action: cover the canvas with crimson, blue in one corner

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: criss-cross light area in the center
steps.load: tiny indian yellow and a little white
steps.motion: little X strokes, blend outward and upward
steps.rule: start at the lightest area and work outward

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: brighter criss-cross above the light area
steps.load: more white with a little cad yellow
steps.rule: work from the lightest area so it darkens outward

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tap bright red into the sky
steps.load: a little white and red tapped into bristles

steps.subject: other: small lavender accents
steps.action: mix crimson and blue and lay in little colors
steps.rule: blue is much stronger, so use more crimson

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the paint with the blender brush
steps.rule: more blending melts it into the background colors

steps.subject: other: highlight accent
steps.action: brighten a spot with white

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: push fan upward for evergreen shapes
steps.load: fan loaded both sides with grey-blue
steps.rule: a little white helps them show on television

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap mist at the base, then lift
steps.rule: lifting softens the tap marks

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: second row of trees, darker lavender
steps.rule: closer things should be darker in value

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: corner of fan for a bigger tree with detail

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap bottom lightly, then lift up
steps.rule: creates the misty illusion

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull white straight down, then across
steps.load: a little white on the canvas
steps.motion: pull straight down, then lightly across
steps.rule: straight down picks up the colors underneath

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: tap white for powdery snow
steps.rule: tapping gives powdery snow

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: blend the snow softly
steps.rule: blending brings the snow together

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: layer white under the trees, working forward
steps.rule: work from the most distant object forward

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: reinforce the reflection with white
steps.rule: make it brighter so it jumps out

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut a straight water line with liquid white
steps.load: a little liquid white on the knife
steps.rule: straight water lines keep water from running out

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: big tree in deep lavender, tapped firmly
steps.motion: tap firmly into the paint, then corner

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: thin sienna and white trunks in back
steps.rule: thin paint sticks to thick paint

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap cool white bushes with corner
steps.rule: a touch of blue cools it

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: one-stroke trunk in brown mix

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: birch bark by barely touching with knife
steps.rule: barely touching leaves gaps like bark

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: dark bark accent down the middle
steps.motion: add a little in the middle
steps.rule: it dries to feel like real bark

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: thin brown limbs

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: small bush at the base of the trunk

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: touch in a different tree, darker around
steps.motion: touch, getting darker around the tree
steps.rule: it gets darker and feels like bark

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: thin brown arms on the tree

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: light-colored stick

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: scrape through with knife so black shows
steps.rule: black canvas shows through as twigs

steps.subject: other: contact paper removal
steps.action: peel off the contact paper

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign with bright red on liner
steps.rule: pick one signature and keep it, it becomes your trademark
